content:
maya: Heads up — scheduling dual-write + backfill for billing_events this Thu 2026-03-19 01:00 UTC. Plan: enable dual-write for ~2h, run sharded backfill, smoke, then cutover. Need smoke lead, rollback owner, and someone to run the post-cutover reconcile.

kevin: I can own the smoke checks. Can you paste the checklist I should run? :thumbsup:

maya: sure — quick smoke checklist below (paste for reference):
```
smoke checklist:
- verify producer latency < 200ms to write path
- check replica lag < 50ms and WAL delay within threshold
- run `SELECT count(*) FROM billing_events WHERE created_at > now() - interval '1 hour';` on primary and new table
- sample reconcile: compare 100 event_ids across both sources (random sample)
- confirm downstream consumers processed new schema (billing-worker logs)
- confirm alerts (billing-errors, backfill-fail) are active/unmuted
```

alex: I will be rollback owner. If dual-write shows divergence we: revert feature-flag, stop the backfill job, and run replay from the producer offset. Rollback steps are in the runbook — I can run it if needed. :ok_hand:

sam: quick Q — how long is the backfill expected to take end-to-end? per-shard estimate?

maya: rough numbers: ~16 shards, each ~20-30m if parallelized. we run 4 workers per shard so wall time ~90-120m plus 30m buffer = ~2.5h. we'll keep the window 01:00-04:00 UTC to be safe.

elena: I'll do a preflight at Wed 2026-03-18 22:00 UTC to warm caches and run a dry-run on staging (same shard map). I'll post results here. ping me if the plan changes.

ops-bot: Reminder — maintenance window scheduled Thu 2026-03-19 01:00-04:00 UTC. Pager: alex (primary), eng-sre on standby.

kevin: For the sample reconcile, should we compare by event_id or external_id? external_id has some duplicates in older data.

maya: use event_id for the reconcile sample, external_id only as secondary check. I'll update the runbook to call this out and add the canary shard list. Tagging @eng-sre for replica health checks pre-window. :eyes:

maya: final ask: if you can confirm ownership in this thread (smoke / rollback / preflight), I'll lock the window and update the deployment calendar.
